manifold-E0Sst5ccqd.brief: The question uses the unweighted average of five poll items for 2026 against a 2025 baseline of 52.6%; it needs at least 54.6%. Gallup's June 2026 Values and Beliefs poll put 'changing one's gender' as morally acceptable at 38%, a record low and below the 40% baseline (NewsBusters citing Gallup, June 11; Washington Times, June 11). Per the creator's June 24 update, three of five items were then available (the Gallup ones) and the two remaining PRRI American Values Survey items must average 57.5%. Their 2025 baselines were 51% (unfair advantages from slavery) and 54% (society too soft and feminine), an average of about 52.5%. PRRI's American Values Survey is normally released in the second half of October; no 2026 release was found as of Oct 12. Sources: https://newsbusters.org/blogs/cnsnews/craig-bannister/2026/06/11/belief-changing-ones-gender-morally-acceptable-falls, https://prri.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/2025-PRRI-American-Values-Survey-Topline.pdf

polymarket-3251602.brief: The Bank of Japan raised its policy rate to 1.25% on Sept 18, 2026 by a 7-2 vote (Asada and Sato wanted to wait), after a June hike to 1%. The next meeting is Oct 29-30. Overnight index swaps and futures price roughly a 25-30% chance of a hike then. Governor Ueda said on Oct 6 the BoJ will keep raising rates, citing the Iran war, AI-related demand and a weak yen (USD/JPY near 158) as upside inflation risks; core inflation excluding fresh food rose to 2.6% in August. A former BoJ executive director said back-to-back hikes have a 20-30% chance, while the September summary of opinions said no need to rush and a Bloomberg survey had 58% of economists expecting the next hike in January and about 35% in December. The question resolves to the bracket for the change in the upper bound of the policy rate. Sources: https://www.fxstreet.com/analysis/the-market-is-pricing-a-boj-pause-heres-why-uedas-keep-raising-rates-could-force-a-sharp-yen-repricing-202610061823, https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/articles/boj-rate-hike-october-real-233000473.html, https://investinglive.com/central-banks/boj-s-ueda-in-focus-as-markets-weigh-a-back-to-back-october-rate-hike/

polymarket-3954617.brief: Oman and Iran announced a framework for a single temporary Hormuz corridor on Aug 25-26, 2026, but only Iran described the terms in detail and Oman's foreign minister had said only that a deal was near. On Oct 7 Iran's foreign ministry spokesman Baghaei said the two had agreed coordinates of safe routes in and out of the strait and how to pass them to the relevant international maritime body (IRNA via Gulf News); no new Omani statement was reported. Talks on a permanent arrangement, traffic management and fees are still to come. Iran says the strait stays closed under IRGC control until U.S. commitments under the June memorandum are met, an IRGC adviser warned on Oct 7 that the southern route along Oman's coast would be blocked, and the U.S. blockade of Iranian ports continues. The question needs both countries to announce acceptance of the same agreement by Oct 31. Sources: https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/iran-oman-deal-reached-on-navigational-corridors-through-hormuz-amid-ongoing-tensions-baghaei-1.500702429, https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/26/iran-oman-agree-on-temporary-hormuz-route-what-we-know, https://maritime-executive.com/article/oman-signals-progress-on-hormuz-shipping-corridor-agreement

polymarket-4641065.brief: The U.S.-Israeli war on Iran began in February 2026. A June memorandum produced a ceasefire that collapsed by July, and the U.S. has blockaded Iranian ports since July 14. The last confirmed CENTCOM strikes on Iranian territory in the sources found were Aug 30 (Larak Island) and Sept 1 (IRGC sites). On Oct 8 President Trump said the U.S. will not attack Iran before the Nov 3 midterm elections while the blockade continues. As of Oct 11 CBS reported no recent U.S. strikes on Iranian territory; on Oct 10 a U.S. jet disabled a cargo ship in the Gulf of Oman, which is at sea and not Iranian territory. Houthi strikes on Riyadh airport on Oct 8-11 killed at least 12, Trump said the U.S. may join Saudi Arabia against the Houthis, and Iran called the U.S. response to its proposals insufficient. The question resolves No only if the U.S. makes an air or surface-to-surface missile strike impacting Iranian territory by Oct 31. Sources: https://cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-war-trump-us-elections-saudi-arabia-yemen-houthis, https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-war-us-strikes-strait-of-hormuz-larak-island/, https://timesofisrael.com/liveblog-october-11-2026

polymarket-4936103.brief: WTI settled at $91.85 on Friday Oct 9, 2026 and traded between $89.61 and $92.62 on Monday Oct 12, near $90.5 in the Asian afternoon (Mitrade). The Oct 8 low was $87.96; Brent settled at $104.72 Friday. WTI had a July low near $66 and a September spike to roughly $104-106. polymarket-5164765.brief: Flydubai flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv diverted to Saudi Arabia on Sept 30, 2026 after the co-pilot allegedly attacked the captain. Media identified the co-pilot as an Omani national, reported barred from flying in Oman over extremist views (AP, WSJ via Al Jazeera, Oct 3). Israeli investigators told CBS (updated Oct 4) that the attack was likely by a single actor, and Netanyahu said it looked like a suicide attempt and that the co-pilot had been Islamist-radicalized, without naming Iran. President Trump said the co-pilot may be linked to Iran, which is not an Israeli government statement. A UAE official said (Haaretz, Oct 9) the co-pilot planned an attack on Ben-Gurion airport; the UAE is leading the investigation and Flydubai flights to Israel remain suspended. The question requires an on-the-record Israeli government statement that Iran or an affiliated group deliberately caused the incident, by Oct 31. Sources: https://www.cbsnews.com/news/flydubai-co-pilot-alleged-hijacking-lone-wolf/, https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/3/who-is-the-mystery-co-pilot-behind-the-flydubai-attack
